text: [[unknown]] There is no verified rule in the database that recognises an astrology certificate as a qualification for German university admission. To find out whether your astrology certificate can count toward admission, check the Anabin database (https://www.anabin.de) and the Uni-Assist admission guidelines (https://www.uni-assist.de/en/how-to-apply). If the certificate is not listed there as a recognised higher-education entrance qualification, it will not be accepted for admission to a German public university.
